أَبُو بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَتْحِ الرَّقِّيُ‌
أَبُو سَعِيدٍ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ بْنِ نَصْرٍ السِّجْزِيُ‌
أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْأَشْكِيُ‌

notes: Long narrative: «لقينا بمكة رجلا من أهل المغرب» is a scene. The old man («أبي الدنيا معمر», named in the text) speaks and relays his sighting of Ali; whether he is a link is not settled (rule 6), so he is not added. «ختن أبي بكر» is a description, left out. The «1-» number is left out.

notes: The two narrators speak in the first person («لقينا بمكة رجلا»): the story of meeting an old man from the Maghrib is their own account, with implicit transmission (rule 11). The old man is in the scene and is not added as a link.
«ختن أبي بكر» after the second name is a descriptor, not part of the name, and is left out.
